title: "1. Define the question: Synthetic practice"

## Your question

::: {.callout-note}
How do community composition, Shannon diversity, and count totals differ between Group A and Group B?
:::

This teaching dataset contains fictional features and two supplied groups. Use it to learn how the workflow behaves before interpreting study data.

## Your dataset

Use **24 samples**, **15 features**, and the supplied groups **Group A (12) and Group B (12)**.

| Location | Folder |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `data/example/` |
| Outputs | `results/example/` |

## Your task

Follow the seven steps in order: define the question, preview results, meet the inputs, check them, run the analysis, explain the evidence, and write the report. Complete workspace setup before starting.
